_note: Primary fields the extractor looks for. Values are always copied as written in the source document, with a verbatim quote. doc_types are hints for which documents to search.

ecog.label: ECOG performance status
ecog.desc: ECOG / WHO performance status as written

clinical_question.label: Question for the Tumour Board
clinical_question.desc: the clinical question the treating team asks the board

recorded_stage.label: Stage as recorded
recorded_stage.desc: TNM / stage exactly as written by the reporting clinician (never derive)

lesion_size.label: Primary lesion size
lesion_size.desc: size of the primary lesion as written in the imaging report

distant_findings.label: Distant disease (imaging)
distant_findings.desc: statement about distant metastatic disease as written

comparison_prior.label: Comparison with prior imaging
comparison_prior.desc: comparison with an earlier study, as written

histologic_type.label: Histologic type
histologic_type.desc: tumour histologic type / diagnosis line as written

grade.label: Grade / differentiation
grade.desc: histologic grade or differentiation as written

pdl1.label: PD-L1
pdl1.desc: PD-L1 result (TPS/CPS, clone) as written, including 'Pending'; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

egfr.label: EGFR
egfr.desc: EGFR mutation result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

alk.label: ALK
alk.desc: ALK result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

ros1.label: ROS1
ros1.desc: ROS1 result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

kras.label: KRAS
kras.desc: KRAS result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

er.label: Estrogen receptor (ER)
er.desc: ER result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

pr.label: Progesterone receptor (PR)
pr.desc: PR result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

her2.label: HER2
her2.desc: HER2 result as written (IHC score and/or ISH result); the final reported status if given; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

ki67.label: Ki-67
ki67.desc: Ki-67 index as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

mmr.label: MMR / MSI status
mmr.desc: mismatch repair IHC or MSI result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

ras_braf.label: RAS / BRAF
ras_braf.desc: KRAS/NRAS/BRAF result as written, including 'Not performed'; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

distance_from_anal_verge.label: Distance from anal verge
distance_from_anal_verge.desc: tumour distance from the anal verge as written

mrf_status.label: Mesorectal fascia (MRF)
mrf_status.desc: MRF / CRM status on MRI as written

emvi.label: EMVI
emvi.desc: extramural venous invasion on MRI as written

wbc.label: WBC count
wbc.desc: total white cell count with unit, or 'Not reported' if so written

treatment_received.label: Treatment received
treatment_received.desc: treatment delivered as documented (dose, fractions, agents, dates)

treatment_completion_date.label: Treatment completion date
treatment_completion_date.desc: date the documented treatment course was completed

patient_preference.label: Patient preference / special circumstances
patient_preference.desc: documented patient preference, consent or special circumstances (for example declines surgery, lives far away, financial constraints) as written

clinical_trial_note.label: Clinical trial availability / suitability
clinical_trial_note.desc: any documented statement about clinical trial availability or suitability, as written

diagnosis_date_mode.label: Date and mode of diagnosis
diagnosis_date_mode.desc: the date and the way the diagnosis was established (for example biopsy on 08-Sep-2026) as written

presenting_complaint.label: Presenting complaints
presenting_complaint.desc: the presenting / chief complaints and their duration as written (for example 'haemoptysis for 6 weeks')
